name: aula-en-red
description: Aula en Red · Punto Digital: quizzes, presentaciones y participación en red local, sin internet.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
